= CouchbaseSnapshotBackupRun Resource
include::partial$autogen-reference-aliases.adoc[tags=couchbasesnapshotbackuprun]
:resource-name-singular: couchbasesnapshotbackuprun
:resource-name-plural: couchbasesnapshotbackupruns
:resource-name-kind: CouchbaseSnapshotBackupRun

CouchbaseSnapshotBackupRun records one CSI VolumeSnapshot based backup attempt.
This is
the authoritative record of what a specific backup actually contains, created by the
operator when a snapshot backup run starts and never authored directly by a user.

The following is an example resource, depicting the overall structure and any defaults (consult the field reference for valid values for "empty" values, such as empty strings etc.):

== couchbasesnapshotbackupruns.spec

=== Constraints

*Required*

*Type*: `object`

=== Description

CouchbaseSnapshotBackupRunSpec records the facts captured at the moment the run
started, which backup schedule produced it, what the source cluster looked like, and
what credential and CR state the captured data expects on restore.

=== couchbasesnapshotbackupruns.spec.adminSecretName

==== Constraints

*Required*

*Type*: `string`

==== Description

AdminSecretName names the Secret holding the administrative credentials the
captured data expects to authenticate with.

=== couchbasesnapshotbackupruns.spec.buckets

==== Constraints

*Type*: `[]string`

==== Description

Buckets, Scopes and Collections record the names that existed at capture time, so
a restore can detect one with no matching CR and require acknowledgement before
proceeding, rather than silently losing it to ordinary reconciliation right after
restore completes.
Buckets is the set of bucket names captured in this run.

=== couchbasesnapshotbackupruns.spec.clusterSpec

==== Constraints

*Required*

*Type*: `object`

==== Description

ClusterSpec is the source cluster's specification as captured at run time, so a
new cluster can be provisioned on restore without reconstructing topology by hand.
This is stored as raw JSON, not the typed spec, so it doesn't have to pass today's
validation rules.

=== couchbasesnapshotbackupruns.spec.clusterUUID

==== Constraints

*Required*

*Type*: `string`

==== Description

ClusterUUID is the source cluster's identity at capture time, recorded for audit
and for the credential continuity behaviour used when restoring to a different
cluster.

=== couchbasesnapshotbackupruns.spec.collections

==== Constraints

*Type*: `[]string`

==== Description

Collections is the set of collection names captured in this run.

=== couchbasesnapshotbackupruns.spec.nodeCount

==== Constraints

*Required*

*Type*: `integer`

==== Description

NodeCount is the number of members captured in this run.

=== couchbasesnapshotbackupruns.spec.scopes

==== Constraints

*Type*: `[]string`

==== Description

Scopes is the set of scope names captured in this run.

=== couchbasesnapshotbackupruns.spec.serverVersion

==== Constraints

*Required*

*Type*: `string`

==== Description

ServerVersion is the Couchbase Server version running on the source cluster at
capture time, checked for compatibility with a restore target before any
destructive action is taken.

=== couchbasesnapshotbackupruns.spec.sourceBackup

==== Constraints

*Required*

*Type*: `string`

==== Description

SourceBackup names the CouchbaseBackup that produced this run, for listing
purposes only.
This is not an ownership relationship, a run must survive
deletion of the schedule that created it.

== couchbasesnapshotbackupruns.status

=== Constraints

*Type*: `object`

=== Description

CouchbaseSnapshotBackupRunStatus records the outcome of the capture attempt, whether it
succeeded, what was actually captured, and how it was captured.

=== couchbasesnapshotbackupruns.status.baselineBalanced

==== Constraints

*Required*

*Type*: `boolean`

==== Description

BaselineBalanced records whether the source cluster was balanced immediately before
the run's capture began.
Compared the same way as BaselineOrchestrator.

=== couchbasesnapshotbackupruns.status.baselineChronicleRev

==== Constraints

*Type*: `integer`

==== Description

BaselineChronicleRev is the source cluster's chronicle revision counter, captured
immediately before the run's capture began.
Only captured on server versions that
support it (8.5.0 and later), left unset on older versions, which rely on
BaselineOrchestrator and BaselineBalanced alone.

=== couchbasesnapshotbackupruns.status.baselineOrchestrator

==== Constraints

*Required*

*Type*: `string`

==== Description

BaselineOrchestrator is the source cluster's orchestrator node name, captured
immediately before the run's capture began.
Compared against the same value read
again after capture, to detect whether the cluster's topology changed mid capture.

=== couchbasesnapshotbackupruns.status.endTime

==== Constraints

*Type*: `string`

==== Description

EndTime is when this run's capture attempt finished, used together with StartTime to
compute MeasuredSkew.

=== couchbasesnapshotbackupruns.status.groupSnapshot

==== Constraints

*Required*

*Type*: `boolean`

==== Description

GroupSnapshot records whether the run was captured as a single
VolumeGroupSnapshot or as concurrent individual VolumeSnapshots, as evidence of
the capture mechanism actually used.

=== couchbasesnapshotbackupruns.status.groupSnapshotName

==== Constraints

*Type*: `string`

==== Description

GroupSnapshotName is the VolumeGroupSnapshot object created for the run, set only
when GroupSnapshot is true.
Its members are created asynchronously by k8s, so the
run's Snapshots list is filled in once that finishes, not here.

=== couchbasesnapshotbackupruns.status.measuredSkew

==== Constraints

*Type*: `string`

==== Description

MeasuredSkew is the actual gap observed between the first and last snapshot
taken in this run, checked against CouchbaseBackup.spec.snapshotBackup.maxSkew.

=== couchbasesnapshotbackupruns.status.phase

==== Constraints

*Type*: `string`

*Default*: `InProgress`

*Enumerations*: `InProgress, Complete, Invalid`

==== Description

Phase is the run's current state.

=== couchbasesnapshotbackupruns.status.snapshots

==== Constraints

*Type*: `[]object`

==== Description

Snapshots is the full list of every volume snapshot taken as part of the run, one
entry per volume.
A restore reads this list directly to know exactly which snapshot
to restore each volume from.

=== couchbasesnapshotbackupruns.status.snapshots.member

==== Constraints

*Required*

*Type*: `string`

==== Description

Member is the name of the pod/member this volume belonged to.

=== couchbasesnapshotbackupruns.status.snapshots.snapshotName

==== Constraints

*Required*

*Type*: `string`

==== Description

SnapshotName is the VolumeSnapshot object holding the capture.

=== couchbasesnapshotbackupruns.status.snapshots.volumeName

==== Constraints

*Required*

*Type*: `string`

==== Description

VolumeName is the PVC name this snapshot was taken from.

=== couchbasesnapshotbackupruns.status.startTime

==== Constraints

*Type*: `string`

==== Description

StartTime is when this run's capture attempt began, used together with EndTime to
compute MeasuredSkew.
